title: 莉莉娅·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 薰衣草粉色头发与分枝鹿角相映，下接棕色四足鹿身。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Lillia is a fae deer being with a young feminine upper body, large deer ears, branching antlers, lavender-pink hair, and a warm brown four-legged deer body. Preserve her established age appearance and nonhuman anatomy without infantilizing or sexualizing her. An opaque long-sleeved lilac tunic fully covers the upper torso; her curved flower staff rests grounded with no swinging or sleep spell.
art_direction.scene: A slightly elevated complete figure, asymmetric curved silhouette, naturally separated hands and a small sunlit ground cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: lavender, fawn brown, leaf green, amber light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
